name: Morv.ai – AI Sales Assistant
author: Morv.ai

sections.description:
Turn your website into a smarter, more engaging experience for your visitors.

Morv is an AI-powered chatbot that helps your visitors find information, get instant answers and discover relevant products. Working from your WordPress pages and posts and your WooCommerce product catalogue, it gives helpful, conversational answers 24/7.

Whether you run an online store, a business website or a content site, Morv helps visitors get the information they need and can reduce repetitive customer enquiries.

Why choose Morv?

  • 24/7 AI customer support. Help visitors find answers to common questions, even outside business hours.
  • Answers from your own content. Morv uses your pages and posts to give relevant, context-aware replies.
  • WooCommerce product help. Help shoppers discover suitable products and get answers about them.
  • Knowledge that keeps up. Your chatbot stays informed as your content changes.
  • Connect in one click. No code to paste and no API keys to copy.
  • Works with block and classic themes.

Built for WooCommerce stores

Morv can use your product catalogue to help shoppers find relevant products, understand their features and make more informed choices, which can make the path to purchase smoother.

Simple setup

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Click Connect and sign in to Morv, or create an account.
  3. Choose your chatbot and approve the connection.
  4. Back in WordPress, the chatbot appears on your site.

Knowledge that stays up to date

When you edit or remove a page or post that is in the chatbot’s knowledge, Morv re-reads it within minutes, and new posts listed in your sitemap can be added too. Content that Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO marks noindex is left out.

Pricing

The plugin is free. It connects your site to Morv, a paid service: you need a Morv plan, and conversations, page reads and product syncs use your plan’s credits. See the plans at morv.ai.

The chat window shows a small “Powered by MORV.ai” credit, drawn by the Morv service’s own script, not by this plugin. The plugin adds no link or credit of its own.

Make your website work smarter

Give your visitors a more helpful website, with an AI assistant that understands your content and helps them find products.

External services

This plugin connects to Morv (morv.ai), an AI chatbot service run by Morv.ai LTD. It sends data to Morv only after you click Connect, and only as listed here.

  • Connect (when you click Connect): your browser goes to https://morv.ai/connect/wordpress carrying this site’s address and name, your settings page’s address, the address of the site’s sitemap, your WordPress and plugin versions, whether WooCommerce is active, your WordPress admin language (so Morv’s pages can be shown in it), and two one-time random values that secure the connection.
  • Exchange (straight after you approve on Morv): this site sends Morv the one-time code, a secret it made before Connect, this site’s address and the WordPress and plugin versions, to https://morv.ai/api/v1/sites/token. Morv answers with the site’s key and the chatbot’s details.
  • Status (when you open the settings page, at most every five minutes, or every minute while Morv cannot be reached; when you click Check again; and once a day): this site sends its key, the WordPress and plugin versions and whether WooCommerce is active to https://morv.ai/api/v1/sites/status, to show whether the chatbot is live.
  • The chat widget (on every page of your site while connected and switched on): on every page view your visitors’ browsers load the widget, its stylesheet and the chatbot’s settings from https://morv.ai, so Morv receives their IP address, their browser’s user agent and the page’s address, whether or not they open the chat. When a visitor uses the chat, their messages, the address of the page they are on, their IP address, their browser’s user agent and how they use the chat (such as opening it or clicking a link in an answer) go to Morv, which answers on your behalf. The widget keeps a random session identifier, the conversation’s identifier, whether the visitor accepted the chat’s data notice and whether they closed its greeting in the browser’s storage; the widget sets no cookies. Product pictures in answers load from wherever the store keeps them (for WooCommerce, this site). Contact details a visitor leaves reach you through Morv.
  • Spam check (when a visitor starts a conversation, and again whenever Morv asks for one): the chat runs a Cloudflare Turnstile check, which the visitor’s browser loads from https://challenges.cloudflare.com. Cloudflare receives the visitor’s IP address, user agent and other signals from the browser, and may set its own cookies. Cloudflare’s Terms of Use, Privacy Policy and Turnstile Privacy Addendum.
  • Page updates (a few minutes after you publish, edit, unpublish or delete a post, page, product or other public content, while that setting is on): this site sends the page’s address and whether it was published, updated or removed to https://morv.ai/api/v1/sites/content. Morv then reads the published page itself. Nothing is sent for posts that Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO mark noindex (Morv drops them at its nightly read of your sitemap), nor for pages WooCommerce’s Coming soon mode hides.
  • Site check (when you click Connect WooCommerce products, and at night if another Morv account has also connected this site’s address): Morv calls this site’s https://your-site/wp-json/morv-ai/v1/proof to confirm the site runs this plugin connected to your Morv account, and which account that is. The answer is a code derived from the site’s key; it reveals nothing else, and the route answers nothing for any other request.
  • Connect WooCommerce products (only when you click it): your browser goes to https://morv.ai/connect/wordpress/woocommerce carrying this site’s connection reference and your settings page’s address, where you confirm on Morv.
  • WooCommerce keys (only when you click Connect WooCommerce products and approve): WooCommerce creates a read-only API key and sends it from your site to https://morv.ai/api/v1/sites/woocommerce/keys. Morv stores it encrypted and reads your products with it. The plugin notes the key’s number (nothing else) so that it can revoke the key once Morv no longer uses it.
  • Disconnect (when you click Disconnect, or delete the plugin, at the address the site was connected from; a copy of the site at another address only forgets the connection and sends nothing): this site tells https://morv.ai/api/v1/sites/disconnect to stop. If Morv cannot be reached when you click Disconnect, the site tries again every hour for a day while the plugin stays active; when you delete the plugin, Morv is told once, so if it cannot be reached then, disconnect the site in your Morv dashboard (the chatbot’s Embed Code page, Connected sites). Morv stops showing the chatbot here and removes the WooCommerce product connection made from this site, with the products it synced, and once Morv no longer uses it, the plugin revokes the read-only key WooCommerce made for Morv. If Morv refuses, the settings page says so and how to disconnect the site on Morv.

Morv’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. From the Plugins screen, click Add New, search for Morv.ai, install Morv.ai – AI Sales Assistant and activate it.
  2. Open Settings, Morv.ai and click Connect to Morv.
  3. Sign in to Morv (or create an account), choose your chatbot and approve.
  4. Back in WordPress, the chatbot loads on your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Morv account?

Yes. The plugin connects your site to a Morv chatbot. You can create an account during Connect.

What does it cost?

The plugin is free. Conversations, page reads and product syncs use the credits of your Morv plan; see morv.ai for the plans.

I already pasted the Morv embed code into my theme.

The widget loads once either way. You can remove the pasted code once the plugin is connected.

What happens if I move my site to a new address?

The plugin stops loading the chatbot and sending anything at the new address. Click Forget this connection there, then connect the new address. If the old site no longer exists, disconnect it in your Morv dashboard (the chatbot’s Embed Code page, Connected sites). A staging copy of your site therefore never shows the chatbot, and forgetting the connection on the copy leaves the live site connected.

What happens when I deactivate the plugin?

The chatbot stops loading and nothing is sent, so a disconnect still waiting to reach Morv is not tried again until you activate the plugin. The connection, and a WooCommerce product connection made from this site, stay on Morv until you click Disconnect or delete the plugin.

Connect says the WordPress Address and Site Address are on different hosts.

Morv connects a site only when its admin and its pages are on the same host (Settings, General). Put both on one host, or add the chatbot to your site with the embed code from your Morv dashboard instead.

1.0.1

  • New name: Morv.ai – AI Sales Assistant (the menu is Settings, Morv.ai). Nothing changes for a connected site.
  • The readme’s Terms and Privacy links are clickable.

1.0.0

  • First release.
